test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Swim with the tide

options.text: Going for a swim during the high tide

solution:
The correct answer is "**Agree with the popular opinion**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**act in accordance with the prevailing opinion or tendency**."
 
• We use the given idiom when referring to people who are often in consensus with the majority point of view or opinion.
 
 
• **Example**: *Sujit would rather **swim with the tide**__ instead of voicing his honest opinion on sensitive issues on social media.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** 

 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**प्रचलित राय या प्रवृत्ति के अनुसार कार्य करें**।"
